title: Natural shift comparison for the integral ordinary direct image
statement:
Fix a prime $\ell$, a finite extension $E/\mathbf Q_\ell$ with valuation ring $\mathcal O_E$ and uniformizer $\varpi_E$, and put $A_{E,n}=\mathcal O_E/\varpi_E^n$ for $n\ge1$ [def-weil-l-adic-coefficient-extension]. Let $f:X\to Y$ be a morphism of schemes on which $\ell$ is invertible [def-weil-scheme-morphism-properties], with small pro-etale sites [def-weil-pbc-proetale-site], completed coefficient sheaves $\widehat{\mathcal O}_{E,X},\widehat{\mathcal O}_{E,Y}$ and ambient derived categories $D(X_{\mathrm{proet}},\mathcal O_E)$, $D(Y_{\mathrm{proet}},\mathcal O_E)$ of modules over them [def-weil-completed-integral-coefficients], with the cochain shift $[r]$, $P[r]^i=P^{i+r}$, $d_{P[r]}=(-1)^rd_P$ [def-weil-triangulated-category]. Let $Rf_*$ be the integral derived direct image of [def-weil-derived-direct-image], $Rf_*K=R\varprojlim_n\operatorname{Res}_nRf_{*,n}(K\otimes^L_{\mathcal O_E}A_{E,n})$, formed from the derived reductions [def-weil-integral-derived-reduction] and the derived limit [def-weil-derived-limit], regarded as a functor $D(X_{\mathrm{proet}},\mathcal O_E)\to D(Y_{\mathrm{proet}},\mathcal O_E)$ in its ambient realization. Then for every $r\in\mathbf Z$ and every $K$ there is an isomorphism
$$\theta_{K,r}:Rf_*(K[r])\xrightarrow{\sim}(Rf_*K)[r]$$
in $D(Y_{\mathrm{proet}},\mathcal O_E)$, natural in all morphisms $K\to K'$ of $D(X_{\mathrm{proet}},\mathcal O_E)$ (including inverses of quasi-isomorphisms), with $\theta_{K,0}=\mathrm{id}$. No constructibility, boundedness or derived completeness of $K$ is assumed.

proof.text: Let S be the chosen coefficientDerivedSystemEvaluationCalculus on X. Its recorded adjunction is S.reduction left adjoint to coefficientSequenceLimit. Apply Mathlib Adjunction.leftAdjointCommShift to transfer the right adjoint shift structure from step 1 to exactly S.reduction. This is a mate construction on natural isomorphisms and therefore applies to all derived arrows and preserves the recorded strict reduction functor and its quotient transitions. It avoids reconstructing reduction as a ringed-topos pullback.

proof.text: Unfold sfAmbientIntegralDirectImage as reduction, exact derived scalar restriction, sfAmbientDerivedTowerPush, and coefficientConstantTowerLimit. The tower direct image is the unbounded right-derived functor of the additive sfAmbientTowerPush. Compose its standard CommShift structure with the other three. Take theta(r) to be the resulting commShiftIso(r). These are natural isomorphisms on the entire ambient derived category, and Functor.commShiftIso_zero gives exactly the stipulated theta(0) equality. No assumptions on boundedness, constructibility, or completeness enter this construction.
